events.text: My Iris TV lost its remote. The label on the back says MODEL: 43G7200.
Did your TV respond when I sent the volume up command? Please let me know so we can continue.
Great! Did the TV mute successfully with this command?
Did the volume decrease when I sent that command?
Did the channel go up with that command?
Did the channel go down correctly?
Did the menu appear on your screen?
That's enough for now, give me the summary.

Here is the summary of your configured remote: it uses the samsung32 protocol at address 14, and supports Volume Up, Volume Down, Mute, Channel Up, and Channel Down. You can return anytime to configure the remaining buttons.
